annotations.title: What a Solana x402 payment needs

description: WHAT A WALLET NEEDS TO PAY AN x402 ENDPOINT ON SOLANA. The `exact` scheme on Solana has the buyer build a version-0 transaction (SetComputeUnitLimit, SetComputeUnitPrice, TransferChecked from their associated token account to the seller’s, then a Memo with `extra.memo` or a random 16-byte nonce), with the seller’s `extra.feePayer` as fee payer, sign it as the token authority and hand it over partially signed in `knock_on_endpoint` as `payment` (base64 JSON with `accepted` and `payload.transaction`). This returns what that needs: a recent blockhash, the token’s decimals and program, and whether the payer’s and the payee’s token accounts exist with their balances. Read-only: nothing is built, signed or sent, and we never hold a key. Free.

mint.description: The base58 token mint the endpoint asks for (the leg’s `asset`).

network.description: solana (default), solana-devnet, or their CAIP-2 ids.

payTo.description: The seller’s address, to read whether its token account exists.

payer.description: The buyer’s wallet, to read its token balance.

tokenProgram.description: The SPL Token or Token-2022 program that owns the mint; the transfer goes through it.
